facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹94,306 cr, +39% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹7,033 cr, +70% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹20,614 cr (+10% YoY), PAT ₹2,393 cr (+114% YoY), operating margin 14.5%.
Revenue has compounded at 23% over 10 years, 32% over 5 and 29% over 3; the last twelve months (+39%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded slower than revenue over 3 years (17% vs 29%): growth is costing margin.
Quarterly revenue growth has decelerated over the last four quarters: +43% → +80% → +29% → +10% YoY.
Operating margin has expanded to 14.5% from 10.0% a year ago (+4.5 pp).
Borrowings are ₹27,638 cr against equity of ₹18,263 cr: debt/equity 1.51× (was 0.79× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 7.7× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 211 days from 191 in Mar 2023 (inventory days 199 → 222): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 52.9%, unchanged over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹7,390 cr of operating cash came from ₹27,569 cr of operating profit: 27% conversion; against PAT of ₹17,378 cr that is 0.4×.
Free cash flow was negative in 2 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹4,736 cr, latest year ₹4,713 cr.

business.what: Titan Company Limited is a lifestyle company primarily engaged in the jewellery, watches, and eyewear businesses. guidance.label: Jewellery EBIT margin
guidance.statement: We still would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.
guidance.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Titan Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery business EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company maintains its center of gravity for jewellery business margin at 11% plus or minus.
guidance.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery business revenue growth
guidance.statement: The company is targeting a healthy double-digit growth in value in the jewellery business.
guidance.quote: I think overall, we are committed to -- I'm just reiterating, we are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery sales growth
guidance.statement: We hope to sustain 15% to 20% growth in jewellery sales.
guidance.quote: in the past, we have said between 15% to 20%. So, in a sense, that holds good and we hope to do that and maybe do a bit better.
guidance.speaker: Arun Narayan

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: beYon store expansion
guidance.statement: We would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities.
guidance.quote: we would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities and then kind of see how that
guidance.speaker: Arun Narayan

verdict.detail: Guidance for beYon, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Eyewear volume growth
guidance.statement: We will continue to deliver volume growth in the range of 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.
guidance.speaker: N. S. Raghavan

verdict.detail: Guidance for Eyewear, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Tanishq store openings
guidance.statement: The target for new Tanishq store openings for the year remains 35 to 40.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Watches EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The watches business aims for a mid-teen EBIT margin of 15% to 16% in the 1-2 year time frame.
guidance.quote: mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Watches & Wearables, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Eyewear revenue growth
guidance.statement: The eyewear division expects to close the year at a growth rate between 13% and 14%.
guidance.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
guidance.speaker: N. S. Raghavan

verdict.detail: Guidance for Eyecare, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company maintains its guidance of 11% to 11.5% EBIT margin for the jewellery division.
guidance.quote: 11 to 11.5 still remains our guidance on which we are trying to work on.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Watches EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company expects to deliver mid-teen EBIT margins for the watches division for the full year.
guidance.quote: I think we are hopeful that mid-teen kind of number we should be able to deliver full year basis for FY ‘26.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Watches, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

claims.claim: Normalized EBIT margin for Titan Jewellery business is 11.1% after adjusting for customs duty gains.
claims.quote: Normalized margin, once you do adjustment for this, on Titan Jewellery business would be 11.1%.

claims.claim: Normalized EBIT margin for Titan Jewellery business is 11.7% after adjusting for customs duty gains and MTM gain reversals.
claims.quote: And if you normalize for that, then TMZ, which is Titan Jewellery business margin, would be 11.7%.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity in the jewellery industry is expected to continue to increase.
claims.quote: Competitive intensity, please expect it to continue to improve and increase all the time.

claims.claim: The company is seeing a secular trend of greater consumer interest in natural diamonds since January.
claims.quote: And from January of this year, we are seeing a secular trend where customers are demonstrating greater interest in natural diamonds.

claims.claim: The company's flywheel is adding a base of customers to the Encircle base from which every brand feeds off.
claims.quote: we have a flywheel which is constantly adding a certain base of customers to our entire Encircle base, from which every brand feeds off.

claims.claim: The company saw a softness in consumer sentiment for about 3 weeks in May, but demand picked up in June.
claims.quote: As a consequence, we did see a softness in consumer sentiment for about 3 weeks' time till the end of May. But by the beginning of June, things started picking up.

claims.claim: The jewellery division EBIT margin was impacted by 75 to 80 basis points due to accounting MTM in inventory.
claims.quote: we have accounting MTM in the inventory, which is -- which caused 75 to 80 basis point jewellery division EBIT upward.

claims.claim: The company's market share in the jewellery industry is still in the single digits.
claims.quote: the headroom is huge, not just for the overall industry, but certainly for us as a company because our market share is also still single digit.

claims.claim: The company reclassified color stone jewellery from the studded category into the gold jewellery category.
claims.quote: Color stone jewellery, which was earlier clubbed under the studded category, we have reclassified that into the gold jewellery

claims.claim: Titan gained 50 to 60 bps market share in Jewellery in FY26 versus FY25.
claims.quote: Our sense is that perhaps we have gained about 50 to 60 bps is our sense on FY26 versus FY25.

claims.claim: Buyer growth in Q4 reached 8% compared to flat growth in the previous nine months.
claims.quote: we have seen resurgence in buyer growth in Quarter 4 and what we have reported is 8% versus a flattish for the period prior to that.

claims.claim: International business became profitable at the operating level for the full year.
claims.quote: one of the positive news for international business, if you look at the full year, at operating level, they became profitable.

claims.claim: The unallocated loss of ₹140 crores in Q4 includes a special reward payment to employees.
claims.quote: Titan, in past also we have spoken about, we have a tradition of sharing that superlative performance by sharing, we call it special reward... It is about ₹100- ₹120 crores roughly.

claims.claim: Formalization of the jewellery industry continues.
claims.quote: And of course, formalization continues, but beyond that, nothing to call out or report.

claims.claim: The month of January has been good, but gold rate volatility makes it too early to guide for the rest of the quarter.
claims.quote: I wouldn't want to leave you all with anything that is indicative of how it may play out in the rest of the quarter but only to say that the month of January has been good.

claims.claim: CaratLane is expected to stay in the low double-digit EBIT margin profile.
claims.quote: I think they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.

claims.claim: Wedding buyers are not discretionary and are staying invested in gold despite price increases.
claims.quote: In general, wedding buyers are the ones who -- where it is not discretionary, and they are the ones who -- therefore, we need to give a lot of comfort to -- from an exchange standpoint.

claims.claim: Titan has a competitive advantage in funding inventory compared to others in the industry.
claims.quote: But certainly, it puts us, in a, I would say, a bit, not huge, but it's an advantage, competitive advantage for us because we are able to at least fund our inventory, I think, better than others.

claims.claim: Post-Diwali sales growth has continued in the same vein as the festive period, supported by the wedding season and exchange offers.
claims.quote: post festive 10 days also that we have seen post the Diwali action, the sales growth has continued to be in the same vein as we saw in festive.

claims.claim: Titan continues to gain market share in East and South India driven by its regionalization strategy.
claims.quote: we have gained share in East and South -- or rather we continue to gain share in East and South driven by our regionalization strategy

claims.claim: The company expects EBIT growth to be slightly slower than revenue growth for the full year due to margin headwinds.
claims.quote: I would expect EBIT growth, absolute amount growth might be slightly slower than the revenue growth for the full year.

claims.claim: The company sustained its national market share in the jewellery segment during Q1.
claims.quote: Quarter 1 summary, we have I think sustained share nationally.

claims.claim: Q1 results included a one-time benefit of INR 100 crores, split equally between jewellery and watches, which will reverse in subsequent quarters.
claims.quote: So, in this quarter, we had a benefit of INR 100 crores one time distributed equally between jewellery and watches.

claims.claim: The international jewellery business turned positive in operating profit during the quarter.
claims.quote: And you would have also noticed that international business has actually turned positive operating profit in this quarter.

synthesis.one_liner: Decelerating revenue growth and rising debt contrast with expanding operating margins and strong trailing earnings execution.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management targeted double-digit growth in jewellery value and hoped to sustain 15% to 20% sales growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Quarterly revenue growth decelerated steadily across four quarters from +80% in Mar 2026 to +10% in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management anticipated EBIT growth to lag revenue growth due to margin headwinds while targeting an 11% jewellery margin.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Operating margin expanded to 14.5% in Sep 2026 (+4.5 pp YoY), driving quarterly PAT up 114% to ₹2,393 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claimed a structural competitive advantage in funding inventory compared to industry peers.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Borrowings rose to ₹27,638 cr (1.51x equity) as inventory days reached 222 and 5-year operating cash conversion was 27%.

synthesis.credibility: The ledger scores 0 delivered and 0 missed out of 11 items because all guidance was segment-level. Management repeatedly deflected analyst queries regarding jewellery margin targets, growth moderation, and competitive discounting.

bull.point: Strong trailing profit execution with expanding TTM earnings.
bull.evidence: TTM PAT reached ₹7,033 cr (+70% YoY) on revenue of ₹94,306 cr (+39%).

bull.point: Operating margin expansion driving sharp quarterly profit gains.
bull.evidence: Sep 2026 operating margin expanded to 14.5% (+4.5 pp), boosting PAT 114% to ₹2,393 cr.

bull.point: Earnings cover interest obligations comfortably despite higher debt.
bull.evidence: LTM operating profit and other income covers interest expense 7.7x.

bear.point: Quarterly revenue growth has decelerated significantly.
bear.evidence: Top-line growth slowed across four quarters from +80% in Mar 2026 to +10% in Sep 2026.

bear.point: Debt leverage has expanded sharply relative to equity.
bear.evidence: Borrowings reached ₹27,638 cr against equity of ₹18,263 cr, elevating debt/equity to 1.51x.

bear.point: Weak historical cash conversion tied up in inventory.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened to 211 days, and 5-year OCF conversion was 27% of EBIT.
